correctness.rationale: Exact matrix coefficients are computed on the normalized Drury–Arveson monomial basis. A finite generating-function identity sums the weight ratios over each homogeneous degree. Grouped nonnegative series prove S2 upper bounds for d<=3 (mixed products) and d<=5 (commutators), while diagonal or first off-diagonal terms give divergence at d>=4 and d>=6 respectively. The weighted slice Schur bound ||C_j|_m||<=sqrt(3/m) for spectator degree m>=1 yields compactness of each mixed product. The 4056 finite consistency checks reproduce combinatorial identities and sample Schur inequalities, but do not replace infinite proofs.
